# airy1-gumbel-lean

> Lean 4 companion to Le Chen and Fei Pu, "Gumbel Fluctuations of the Maximum of the Airy_1 Process" (arXiv 2611.23658). It proves that the maximum over [0, T] of a constructed Airy_1 process, centred and scaled as in the paper, converges to the Gumbel law, assuming three named inputs. It does not certify the whole manuscript.

Claim boundary (read first):
- Headline: `Airy1Gumbel.gumbel_limit_continuum_real_normalized_airy1_final₂` in Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean.
- Its hypotheses: `Airy1FddPositive` (finite-dimensional Airy_1 laws), `GOELeftTail` (cubic one-point left tail), `CubicStrongMixing` (cubic strong mixing). These are assumptions, not theorems.
- The mesoscopic step uses a two-time Fredholm determinant bound, not the paper's association and covariance argument; the paper's Lemmas 4.1-4.2 and Remark 5.3 are not formalized, and Proposition 4.3 only in the specialisation used in Section 5.2 (along the two-point route).
- Axioms: `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only; no `sorry`.

## Required context
- [README](README.md): result, inputs, what is not proved, build commands.
- [coverage.yaml](coverage.yaml): the paper-to-Lean map against arXiv 2611.23658v1.
- [claims.yaml](claims.yaml) and [contrib/claims.yaml](contrib/claims.yaml): the named Lean results.
- [Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean](Airy1Gumbel/FinalHeadlineTP.lean): the headline.
- [Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean](Airy1Gumbel/ExternalInputs.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean](Airy1Gumbel/FddRecord.lean), [Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean](Airy1Gumbel/GOELeftTail.lean): the named inputs.

## Gates
- Build: `lake exe cache get && lake build Airy1Gumbel Airy1GumbelContrib`.
- Audit: `lake env lean AxiomCheck.lean > t.txt && python3 scripts/audit.py t.txt` (exact theorem inventory, approved axioms, no proof escapes); the same for contrib/.
- Comparator: Challenge.lean (Mathlib-only statements of Theorem 1.1, with the objects defined in ChallengeDefs/Airy1Gumbel/), Solution.lean (proofs from the package), comparator.json.
- Receipts: verify.sh and contrib/verify.sh, run through lean-pkg.

## Optional
- [contrib/](contrib/): Gumbel law, Airy functions, Mills ratio, Hilbert-Schmidt and trace-class operators, Fredholm determinants, Airy_1 finite-dimensional and two-time estimates.
